text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I visited a local dry cleaner's with Royce and Royce—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad the racewear maintenance
went smoothly without any issues."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
No color fading on the jacket.
Looks like you used the detergent I specified.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The appearance of the white parts changes easily under lighting, so I'll need to double-check them when I get home.
choice_data_list: You really care a lot about "color," don't you?
You really care a lot about "color," don't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Especially when it comes to this racing attire, you see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Wondering why it catches your eye?
Well, you see—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, we arrived
at Royce and Royce's family home."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Angle your feet parallel
with the track." ...Hehe.
I remember checking my posture in the mirror like that.
choice_data_list: Does that Western book have something to do with the color of your racing racewear?
Does that Western book have something to do with the color of your racing racewear?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Half right.
To read training books from all over the world—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That yellow book on the shelf over there.
Back then, it was my trusted partner.
choice_data_list: (A "yellow" book...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I pick up the yellow book lying where my gaze fell.
It was an English dictionary.

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
"First, lie on your back."
...Umm, so lie facing up, right!

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text: With this dictionary, even difficult books will be a breeze! Heheheh!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The book that nurtured my intellect.
Yellow is, to me, the color of intelligence—"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The color that makes me who I am.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Next is the "Orange" jacket!
So with that said—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I will perform the 'Carrot Escalator' here.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You played it too when you were little, didn't you?
That game where you could only climb the stairs
while shouting "Caaaarrot!" to see who got the highest.
choice_data_list: Oh yeah, there was a game like that.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The goal is the observation deck at the top. Alright, let's get started!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Take a deep breath, and hold it.
And from there, all at once...!
choice_data_list: Caaaaaaarrooooooooooot!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: CARROOOOOOOOOOOOOT!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Out of breath, I stopped halfway up the stairs.
Royce and Royce's back quickly disappeared
into the distance...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... whew! I win.
Which means this view—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The sky above this summit belongs to me!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text:
"Only one carrot all the way to the goal again~?!
Amazing, amazing! Why are you so strong~?!"

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thank you! There's a trick to it!
First, you gotta train your 'lung capacity'!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The respectful gazes gathered beneath the orange sunset.
The formative experience of knowing the joy of victory.
choice_data_list: So orange really is the color of victory.
So orange really is the color of victory, huh?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right.
All that's left is "Blue and White."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Next, we'll be using the VR Umulator.
The setting will be a realistic race.
Your opponent will be—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh, she.
choice_data_list: Tokai Teio...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I've incorporated my latest analytical data.
Now, let us begin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce dashed off vigorously.
She kept up the momentum and accelerated smoothly, but—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Wha, she's closed the gap already...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ngh... Not yetttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I lost.
Why—
choice_data_list: ...Royce, there's no need to be down—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Why, I wonder? Her acceleration has increased compared to before.
...I see, her stride has widened.
Did her hips gain even more range of motion?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu.
If that's the case, it'll be easy to come up with a strategy!
choice_data_list: Huh? If anything, she looks like she's having fun...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Because—just as she did back then,
she continues to inspire me.

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I lost... in a race...?
...That girl in the blue and white jersey...
Tokai... Teio-san...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text: ""I can tell even from the video... Teio-san's movements are so supple, yet so powerful... completely different from mine!""

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I can't win... But no, I will show them I can.
If she has natural physical gifts,
I will overcome her with intellectual diligence...!"

text_block_list.name: Young Royce
text_block_list.text: "The 'strongest'—is ME!!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Unforgettable frustration, a vow to be the "strongest."
This blue and white spurs me forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yellow, orange, blue, white.
The colors of the racing silks held various meanings.
All of which were—
choice_data_list: Your whole life is packed into this racing outfit, isn't it?
Your whole life story is woven into this racing attire, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, everything that makes me who I am!
choice_data_list: I want to add my color to that, too.
I want to add my color to that, too.
Let's try it again in VR.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes, everything that makes me who I am!
choice_data_list: I want to add my color to that, too.
I want to add my color to that, too.
Let's try it again in VR.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh.
I wonder what kind of color you'll give me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm really looking forward to it♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Well then, let us increase the probability of victory.
Enter the VR as well and provide advice."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Everything I have that Teio-san doesn't—
I'm going to throw it all at her!
